## ✅ Self-review checklist

<!-- The bar for merging. Be honest. -->

- [ ] My code follows the project's style guide (run `pnpm lint`)
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code
- [ ] I have commented hard-to-understand areas
- [ ] I have made corresponding changes to the documentation
- [ ] My changes generate no new warnings (`pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm lint`)
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works
- [ ] New and existing unit tests pass locally (`pnpm test`)
- [ ] Any dependent changes have been merged and published
- [ ] Accessibility (a11y): keyboard nav, contrast, ARIA labels
- [ ] Performance: no obvious regressions (bundle size, render time)
- [ ] Security: no secrets committed, inputs validated
- [ ] Mobile / responsive checked (if UI change)
- [ ] Lighthouse / Core Web Vitals not regressed (if perf-sensitive)
